How bold text works

These are separate Unicode characters, not a bold font setting. The generator changes basic Latin A–Z, a–z and digits; accents, emoji and other scripts keep their original form.

Where it helps

Use bold for a short display name or one phrase. Keep links, addresses and essential instructions in ordinary text so they remain easy to find and read.
